name: Cloud of Razors, Mass
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as cloud of razors except it affects multiple targets.
